---
title: "What is a self-energy physically?"
description: "Everything the rest of the system does to a particle: a shift of its energy and a finite lifetime."
categories: [excitations]
order: 10
date: 2026-08-12
draft: true
---

::: {.oneline}
The self-energy is the correction to a particle's propagation caused by its interaction with everything else. Its real part shifts the energy; its imaginary part gives a finite lifetime.
:::

## Short answer

*To write.* The self-energy is the correction to a particle's propagation caused by its interaction with everything else. Its real part shifts the energy; its imaginary part gives a finite lifetime.
